The '''Underwalkers''' were a species native to [[Makeb]].<ref name="Underwalker" /> There was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Underwalker on the planet [[Oricon]] named [[Nefra]], who guarded the [[Dread Fortress]] there during the [[Dread War]].<ref name="DF">{{TORcite|type=operation|Dread Fortress}}</ref>
